description: Add a text or logo watermark to a photo. Size is a % of the photo width, margin a % of the shorter side, so the result looks the same on any resolution. One of 9 positions or tiled across the whole image (brick pattern), with opacity, rotation, colour, weight and a soft shadow for text. Logo: any image (PNG with transparency works best). Output keeps the input format (JPEG/PNG/WebP) or as chosen; name <name>-watermarked.<ext>. Text uses the Inter font when installed, else a system sans-serif. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/watermark/

image.description: The photo: a local file path (absolute, or relative to the server's --root) or base64 data (raw or a data: URI).

logo.description: Use this image as the watermark instead of text: a local path or base64.

margin.description: Margin from the edge in % of the shorter side; spacing between tiles when tiled. Default 4.

output.description: Where to write the result: a file path, or a folder ending in "/". Default: the server output folder (a temp folder unless --out-dir is set).

position.description: Where the watermark sits (ignored when tiled). Default bottom-right.

quality.description: Quality 1-100 for JPEG / WebP / AVIF (ignored for PNG). Default 92, same as the website.

returnBase64.description: Also return the output as base64 in the result (only for small files). Default false.

rotation.description: Rotation in degrees (e.g. -30 for a diagonal tile). Default 0.

shadow.description: Soft drop shadow behind text. Default true.

size.description: Watermark width as % of the photo width. Default 28.

text.description: Watermark text (ignored when a logo is given). Default "© Your Name".

tiled.description: Repeat the watermark across the whole photo.

name: image_watermark
title: Watermark image
